metadata.name: ww-input-file
metadata.description: A file upload input displaying uploaded files as a grid of thumbnails with an add button, drag & drop support, size/count/type validation, and optional Base64 or Binary encoding.
features: Grid of file items with image thumbnails and a fallback file icon + name for non-image files
Add button with configurable icon, label and styling
Per-item remove button with configurable icon, size, colors, border, shadow and hover-only visibility
Validation for min/max file size, max total size, max number of files and file type
Initial value support: existing files are tracked separately from new uploads and deletions
Optional Base64 and Binary encoding of uploaded files
Form container integration with field name and custom validation

properties.name: initialValue
properties.description: Array of existing items used to initialize the component. These are tracked separately from new uploads and are moved to deletedFiles when removed.

properties.name: addLabelValue
properties.description: Text label displayed below the add button icon. Leave empty to show the icon only.

properties.name: drop
properties.description: Allow files to be dropped onto the component

properties.name: maxFileSize
properties.description: Maximum size per file, in MB

properties.name: minFileSize
properties.description: Minimum size per file, in MB

properties.name: maxTotalFileSize
properties.description: Maximum combined size of all files, in MB

properties.name: maxFiles
properties.description: Maximum number of files. Set to 1 for single file mode, where the file input stops accepting multiple files.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether at least one file is required

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable the component, blocking uploads, drag & drop and file removal. Hides the remove buttons.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Prevent uploads and file removal while keeping the files visible. Hides the remove buttons.

properties.name: extensions
properties.description: Filter accepted files by type

properties.name: customExtensions
properties.description: Comma-separated list of accepted extensions (e.g. '.html, .xml'). Inactive when extensions is not 'custom'.

properties.name: exposeBase64
properties.description: Include a base64 string on each uploaded file. Base64 strings are cropped in the editor interface but complete in the variable.

properties.name: exposeBinary
properties.description: Include binary data on each uploaded file. Binary data appears as an empty object in the editor interface.

properties.name: errorMsgMaxFilesReached
properties.description: Error message when the max number of files is already reached. Placeholder: {max}.

properties.name: errorMsgTooManyFiles
properties.description: Error message when more files are selected than the remaining slots. Placeholder: {available}.
properties.defaultValue: Only {available} more file(s) can be added

properties.name: errorMsgFileTooSmall
properties.description: Error message when a file is below the min file size. Placeholders: {size}, {min}. Inactive when minFileSize is 0.
properties.defaultValue: File size ({size} MB) is below minimum ({min} MB)

properties.name: errorMsgFileTooLarge
properties.description: Error message when a file exceeds the max file size. Placeholders: {size}, {max}.
properties.defaultValue: File size ({size} MB) exceeds maximum ({max} MB)

properties.name: errorMsgTotalSizeExceeded
properties.description: Error message when the combined size exceeds the max total size. Placeholders: {total}, {max}.
properties.defaultValue: Total size ({total} MB) exceeds maximum ({max} MB)

properties.name: errorMsgInvalidType
properties.description: Error message when a file type is not allowed. Placeholders: {type}, {allowed}. Inactive when extensions is 'any'.
properties.defaultValue: File type "{type}" is not allowed. Accepted: {allowed}

properties.name: gridColumns
properties.description: Number of columns in the grid. Set to 0 for automatic layout where items wrap.

properties.name: gridGap
properties.description: Gap between file items and the add button

properties.name: itemsAspectRatio
properties.description: CSS aspect-ratio applied to both file items and the add button, e.g. '1 / 1', '4 / 3', '16 / 9'.

properties.name: itemsBorderRadius
properties.description: Border radius of file items and the add button

properties.name: addIcon
properties.description: Icon displayed in the add button. Always use icon full names, e.g. 'lucide/upload'.

properties.name: addIconColor
properties.description: Color of the add button icon

properties.name: addIconSize
properties.description: Size of the add button icon

properties.name: addButtonIconGap
properties.description: Gap between the add button icon and its label

properties.name: addButtonBackground
properties.description: Background color of the add button

properties.name: addButtonBorder
properties.description: Border of the add button

properties.name: addButtonFocusOutline
properties.description: Outline shown on the add button when it has keyboard focus

properties.name: addLabelFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the add button label

properties.name: addLabelFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the add button label

properties.name: addLabelColor
properties.description: Color of the add button label

properties.name: addButtonOpacity
properties.description: Opacity of the add button, between 0 and 1

properties.name: fileItemsOpacity
properties.description: Opacity of the file items, between 0 and 1

properties.name: itemsBorder
properties.description: Border of the file items

properties.name: imageObjectFit
properties.description: CSS object-fit of image thumbnails

properties.name: imageObjectPosition
properties.description: CSS object-position of image thumbnails, controlling where the image is anchored in the file item. Has no visible effect when imageObjectFit is 'fill'.

properties.name: removeIconVisibility
properties.description: When the remove button is displayed on a file item: 'always' shows it at all times, 'hover' only reveals it when the file item is hovered or the button has keyboard focus.

properties.name: removeIcon
properties.description: Icon displayed in the remove button of each file item. Always use icon full names, e.g. 'lucide/x'.

properties.name: removeIconSize
properties.description: Width and height of the remove button

properties.name: removeIconInnerSize
properties.description: Size of the icon inside the remove button, as a percentage of the button size

properties.name: removeIconColor
properties.description: Color of the remove button icon

properties.name: removeIconBackground
properties.description: Background color of the remove button

properties.name: removeIconBorderRadius
properties.description: Border radius of the remove button

properties.name: removeIconBorder
properties.description: Border of the remove button

properties.name: removeIconShadow
properties.description: Box-shadow of the remove button

properties.name: removeIconFocusOutline
properties.description: Outline shown on the remove button when it has keyboard focus

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: Field name used for form data when inside a form container. Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy).

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable custom validation formula. Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy).

properties.name: validation
properties.description: Custom validation formula. Inactive when the element is not in a form container or when customValidation is false.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy) or when customValidation is false.

states.name: dragging
states.description: A file is being dragged over the component

states.name: file-items-icon-hover
states.description: The remove button of a file item is hovered. Also keeps the remove button visible on the canvas when removeIconVisibility is 'hover'.

events.name: change
events.description: Triggered when files are added or removed

events.name: error
events.description: Triggered when a file fails validation

actions.label: Clear Files
actions.description: Remove all files. Existing files are moved to deletedFiles.

actions.label: Remove File
actions.description: Remove a file by its index in allFiles

variables.name: value
variables.description: Object holding existingFiles (from initialValue, not removed), newFiles (uploaded in this session), deletedFiles (removed existing items) and allFiles (existingFiles + newFiles)

specifications: Local context is exposed under context.local.data?.['fileUpload'] with existingFiles, newFiles, deletedFiles, allFiles, status and error.
Set maxFiles to 1 for single file mode; any higher value allows multiple selection up to that count.
existingFiles come from initialValue and are never re-uploaded; removing one moves it to deletedFiles so the backend can delete it.
Only image files get a thumbnail; other file types show a generic file icon with a truncated file name.
Set removeIconVisibility to 'hover' for a cleaner grid; the button stays keyboard-accessible because it also appears on :focus-visible.
To style the remove button on canvas while removeIconVisibility is 'hover', select the file-items-icon-hover state.
Enable exposeBase64 or exposeBinary only when the workflow needs the file payload, since both add significant weight to the variable.
Inside a form container, set fieldName so the file data is included in the form submission.
